summary: Inbox uses c to add a note to the highlighted answer option. Notes remain attached to their options when the highlight changes; the chosen option and every note on the other named options are sent together, with the send line listing those notes. Free custom answers have a distinct entry when permitted. Named answers without notes still send, without turning their summary into a note, and unstructured requests retain their reply editor. Keyboard and mouse follow the same answer behavior; visible Send buttons work on unfocused drafts, and refused answers retain their notes and an inline error.

schema.detail: Answer inputs and stored typed answers accept optional option_notes entries containing a named option id and nonblank text. No database or schema-version changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or digest changes; no coordinated upgrade required.

compatibility.detail: The TUI requires person-answer-option-notes version 1 before sending other-option notes, refusing and retaining drafts on older daemons. Answers without these notes omit the field. Summaries retain all notes for older tolerant readers; older strict schema validators may refuse extended answers.

downtime.detail: No expected interruption or additional startup work.

manual.detail: No configuration changes or re-pairing required.

recovery.detail: A refused Inbox answer restores its option binding and every note in the running TUI. The error remains inline on the restored request until the person acts, rather than disappearing with a transient flash. Drafts are not persisted across TUI restarts.
